subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should TUI local-shell results become durable transcript entries, with session-consented `!` output entering model context and `!!` remaining history-only?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but the repository has no established contract for persisting local shell output or assigning `!!` a history-only meaning; this permanently defines sensitive-data, UX, and Gateway protocol behavior.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the proposed consent and prefix semantics, document the compatibility and sensitive-data behavior, and require real Gateway plus resume proof before merge.

options.title: Use explicit per-command sharing
options.body: Keep existing `!` behavior local-only and introduce a less ambiguous explicit modifier or command for transcript and model sharing.

options.title: Decline persistence
options.body: Retain local-shell output as an ephemeral TUI-only convenience and close the feature direction without adding the Gateway method.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed consent and prefix semantics, document the compatibility and sensitive-data behavior, and require real Gateway plus resume proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway and transcript architecture work makes this the strongest available owner for deciding whether the new durable protocol and product semantics belong in core.
